extension.summary: Founders Theater: a community Kodi add-on for Silo
extension.description: Founders Theater is a community add-on for Silo media servers, not an official Silo app. Browse your Silo library with a TV interface modeled on the Silo Android TV app, choose a media file and resume movies and episodes from your saved position.
extension.disclaimer: Founders Theater is not made or endorsed by the Silo project. Select HDR and Dolby Vision settings that your device and display support.
extension.news: v1.1.0 (2026-11-24) - Watch Party, where your Silo server offers it: join with a code from the profile menu, or host one from a title page's More menu, and watch in step with everyone. - Movie and series pages show the collections that hold them. - A collection's page can be sorted, filtered and shuffled. - Series and season pages offer Start over, Version, Audio and Subtitles for the episode up next. - OK on an episode plays it; hold OK to mark it watched or a favorite, or to open its page. The episode row runs on into the next and previous season. - Hold OK on a title card to mark it watched or add it to your watchlist or favorites, and on Continue Watching to play or resume it. - Search says where Kodi's keyboard takes speech: hold OK on Android, or Return on a Mac. - Play next still starts the next episode when the file ends during the Up next countdown. - The FT icon in the top-left corner of every screen and on the website.
